Carrier checks, helpful news later this week
We write to travelers
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to know that companion animal trips with Aurelia Skyways should be prepared with care, calm, and clear contact with our desk.

Our team helps with the usual travel steps for pets and support animals, and the welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs before departure. Please keep carriers secure, label belongings clearly, and share any special handling notes early so our staff can give steady support from check-in to arrival. If a crate is lost, <<FACT F118>> and our desk will guide you through the next steps.

We also want travelers to understand that an incident in transit is reviewed with care and by the proper service team. <<FACT F114>> Please report any concern as soon as you can so the record stays clear and your companion receives prompt attention. For journeys with Buddy or any other pet, a calm handoff and careful paperwork help us protect everyone involved.

If you need help planning a trip, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
